title: David Leitch Says Ocean’s 14 Has a Strong Script, but Scheduling Remains the Obstacle
excerpt:
The director says enthusiasm for the heist sequel remains high.
A completed script has not yet solved the challenge of assembling its cast.
body_md:
David Leitch has offered an encouraging but carefully qualified update on Ocean’s 14. The filmmaker attached to direct the next installment says the project has a strong screenplay and considerable support from those involved. What it does not yet have is an easy solution to the scheduling puzzle posed by a large group of busy performers.

Speaking with People, Leitch praised the work of George Clooney and his Smokehouse Pictures producing partner Grant Heslov. He described their script as excellent and stressed that the team is motivated to move forward. His comments also make clear that enthusiasm should not be confused with a confirmed production start. Bringing everyone together remains the practical obstacle.

The modern Ocean’s series began with Steven Soderbergh’s 2001 remake of the 1960 Rat Pack caper. Clooney played Danny Ocean and returned for Ocean’s Twelve in 2004 and Ocean’s Thirteen in 2007. The films established an ensemble formula in which chemistry, elaborate schemes and a relaxed sense of humor were as important as the mechanics of the heists themselves.

Leitch entered early talks to direct the next installment in January 2025. Clooney subsequently discussed Warner Bros. approving a budget and expressed an expectation that cameras could roll during 2026. The latest interview does not establish that the expected start has occurred, and it provides no revised filming date or theatrical release date.

Should the sequel proceed, it would become the first mainline entry without Soderbergh directing. The franchise has already explored a different creative team through Gary Ross’s Ocean’s 8, the 2018 spinoff led by Sandra Bullock as Danny’s sister Debbie. Leitch’s involvement would represent a separate transition for the central series rather than a continuation of that spinoff.

Another Ocean’s project is also being developed independently: a prequel to Ocean’s 11 with Bradley Cooper attached to write and direct. Ryan Gosling and Margot Robbie are slated to portray Danny Ocean’s parents. That film is distinct from Ocean’s 14, and progress on one should not be treated as confirmation of progress on the other.

For now, the concrete development is the director’s positive assessment of the script and the sustained interest in making the sequel. Whether the familiar ensemble can align its calendars will determine how quickly the production can advance.
seo_title: David Leitch Updates Ocean’s 14 Production Plans
seo_description: David Leitch praises the Ocean’s 14 script from George Clooney and Grant Heslov while acknowledging scheduling obstacles.
